No MFA, role changes, live migration, legal publication, or release is included.

questions.question: Does this change admission, trust, permissions, or what untrusted content can reach? Record the guarantee that holds after the change.
questions.answer: Checked current access supplies the actor and trusted tenant. The write accepts POST only, exact configured Origin, bounded exact-once form fields and a valid session CSRF token before one coordinator call. The displayed removable hint grants no authority; the coordinator still rechecks actor, exact target/revision, all grants and last-active-Admin safety after durable admission. Only named membership metadata reaches customer Audit capture.

questions.question: Does a client, a user or an operator see a different input, output, error or default? Record the promise.
questions.answer: Members adds native confirmation and Cancel. The POST returns a fixed applied/refused/busy/unknown response independently of a later Members GET and offers no replay form. Self-removal uses existing identity-only organization selection, signup recovery and reauthentication. AuditLog adds a removal action/membership target and safe outcomes; existing invitation action-to-target pairs remain valid. Capture failure cannot change a removal result, settle a hold or replay the write.
